title: Source Proxy Level 4 first hard artifact complexity proof locked 10

threshold.go: 8/10 Level 4 behavior PASS with clean anti-cheat, clean anti-tailoring, no score warnings, no false-positive/false-negative corrections
threshold.partial_go: 6/10 or 7/10 Level 4 behavior PASS with clean integrity and useful diagnostics
threshold.no_go: 5/10 or less Level 4 behavior PASS, or major generalization failure, with intact evidence
threshold.needs_instrumentation: Existing probes cannot fairly evaluate Level 4 complexity
threshold.needs_fix: Runner/evidence/test pipeline breaks or integrity contamination appears

prompts.prompt: make a laundry timer that can start pause reset and log a finished load
expected_behaviors: Start visibly changes timer/time state.
Pause freezes or changes status.
Reset returns to initial state if present.
Log/finish adds a visible finished-load/history entry if present.
prompts.expected_behavior: Start visibly changes timer/time state. Pause freezes or changes status. Reset returns to initial state if present. Log/finish adds a visible finished-load/history entry if present.
